52364-the-romance-of-a-princess-a-comedy.title: Other Poems
52364-the-romance-of-a-princess-a-comedy.creator: Unknown
52364-the-romance-of-a-princess-a-comedy.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. A door on the left leads to the palace  courtyard; another, centre back, opens into private apartments,  which have no other entrance. The room is furnished befitting the  dignity of a princess. Emma, in gala-attire, has just returned from  a great function in honour of the Calif Haroun-al-Rashid's  ambassadors. Etta helps remove her cloak. The princess then throws  herself on a couch, while Etta stands before her admiringly._

72398-the-right-hand.title: Left-Handedness
72398-the-right-hand.creator: Unknown
72398-the-right-hand.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. be to a large extent abortive. In its combination of strength with delicacy, it is an index of character in all its variations in man and woman from childhood to old age. It is an exponent of the refinement of high civilisation, no less than the organ of all dexterity and force of the skilled inventor and mechanician.

79184-pariahs-of-piperock.title: Pariahs Of Piperock
79184-pariahs-of-piperock.creator: Unknown
79184-pariahs-of-piperock.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “Wonder what Magpie Simpkins will do for a job if ‘Scenery’ Sims is elected sheriff? When me and you didn’t vote, Ike, local option becomes an issue. Be funny if Yaller Rock County goes dry by one vote.”

arxiv-2003-01327.title: Framework of Fracture Network Modeling using Conditioned Data with Sequential Gaussian Simulation
arxiv-2003-01327.creator: Yerlan Amanbek 1,, Timur Merembayev 1,2,, Sanjay Srinivasan
arxiv-2003-01327.description: Abstract The fracture characterization using a geostatistical tool with conditioning data is a computationally efficient tool for subsurface flow and transport applications.The main objective of the paper is to propose a framework of geostatistical method to model the fracture network.

arxiv-2201-13315.title: Some definite integrals involving Jacobi polynomials.
arxiv-2201-13315.creator: Enno Diekema
arxiv-2201-13315.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Enno Diekema. Szmytkowski derived a certain integral with Gegenbauer polynomials. A natural generalization is to derive lookalike integrals with Jacobi polynomials. Six methods are treated to derive the first integral. The first method should be enough to prove the first integral, but by the other methods there arises remarkable formula such as par example a zero-balanced F 3 F_{3} Appell function which can be converted into a F 1 2 {}_{2}F_{1} hypergeometric function. Another three integrals complete the paper.

arxiv-2205-15454.title: Hard-core attractive Yukawa fluid global isomorphism with the lattice gas model
arxiv-2205-15454.creator: A. Katts, V.L. Kulinskii
arxiv-2205-15454.description: Abstract In this work we study the global isomorphism between the liquid-vapor equilibrium of the hard-core attractive Yukawa fluid (HCAYF) and that of the Lattice Gas (LG) model of the Ising-like type. The applicability of the global isomorphism transformation and dependence of its parameters on the screening length of the Yukawa potential are discussed.

arxiv-2208-10412.title: Hamiltonian derivation of the point vortex model from the two-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation
arxiv-2208-10412.creator: Jonathan Skipp, Jason Laurie, Sergey Nazarenko
arxiv-2208-10412.description: Abstract We present a rigorous derivation of the point vortex model starting from the two-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation, from the Hamiltonian perspective, in the limit of well-separated, subsonic vortices on the background of a spatially-infinite strong condensate. As a corollary, we calculate to high accuracy the self-energy of an isolated elementary Pitaevskii vortex, for the first time.

arxiv-2304-06573.title: Continuity of Monge–Ampère Potentials with Prescribed Singularities
arxiv-2304-06573.creator: Quang-Tuan Dang
arxiv-2304-06573.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Quang-Tuan Dang. We study the continuity of solutions to complex Monge–Ampère equations with prescribed singularity type. This generalizes the previous results of DiNezza–Lu (J Reine Angew Math 727:145-167, 2017) and the author (Int Math Res Not 14:11180-11201, 2022). As an application, we can run the pluripotential Monge–Ampère flows in (J Funct Anal 282(6):65, 2022) starting at a current with prescribed singularities. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 32U15, 32Q15, 32W20 1.

arxiv-2405-06636.title: Federated Document Visual Question Answering: A Pilot Study
arxiv-2405-06636.creator: Khanh Nguyen, Dimosthenis Karatzas
arxiv-2405-06636.description: Abstract An important handicap of document analysis research is that documents tend to be copyrighted or contain private information, which prohibits their open publication and the creation of centralised, large-scale document datasets. Instead, documents are scattered in private data silos, making extensive training over heterogeneous data a tedious task.

arxiv-2406-08934.title: Tully-Fisher Relation of Late-type Galaxies at 0.6 ≤ z ≤ 2.5 0.6\leq z\leq 2.5
arxiv-2406-08934.creator: Gauri Sharma, ,, Varenya Upadhyaya, Paolo Salucci, Shantanu Desai
arxiv-2406-08934.description: Abstract We present a study of the stellar and baryonic Tully-Fisher relation within the redshift range of 0.6 ≤ z ≤ 2.5 0.6\leq z\leq 2.5 utilizing observations of star-forming galaxies. This dataset, as explored in Sharma et al. (2023) , comprises of disk-like galaxies spanning a stellar mass range of 8.

arxiv-2412-13115.title: Koopman Mode-Based Detection of Internal Short Circuits in Lithium-ion Battery Pack
arxiv-2412-13115.creator: Sanchita Ghosh, Soumyoraj Mallick, Tanushree Roy
arxiv-2412-13115.description: Abstract Monitoring of internal short circuit (ISC) in Lithium-ion battery packs is imperative to safe operations, optimal performance, and extension of pack life. Since ISC in one of the modules inside a battery pack can eventually lead to thermal runaway, it is crucial to detect its early onset.

arxiv-2507-18485.title: Active Δ \Delta -learning with universal potentials for global structure optimization
arxiv-2507-18485.creator: Joe Pitfield, Mads-Peter Verner Christiansen, Bjørk Hammer
arxiv-2507-18485.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Joe Pitfield, Mads-Peter Verner Christiansen, Bjørk Hammer. Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) have recently been formulated and shown to generalize well. When applied out-of-sample, further data collection for improvement of the uMLIPs may, however, be required.

arxiv-2509-01049.title: Neural Network Solution of Non-Markovian Quantum State Diffusion and Operator Construction of Quantum Stochastic Process
arxiv-2509-01049.creator: Jiaji Zhang, Carlos L. Benavides-Riveros, Lipeng Chen
arxiv-2509-01049.description: Abstract Non-Markovian quantum state diffusion provides a wavefunction-based framework for modeling open quantum systems. In this work, we introduce a novel machine learning approach based on an operator construction algorithm. This algorithm employs a neural network as a universal generator to reconstruct the stochastic time evolution operator from an ensemble of quantum trajectories.

arxiv-2512-03270.title: Curvature Potential Formulation for Thin Elastic Sheets
arxiv-2512-03270.creator: Yael Cohen, Animesh Pandey, Yafei Zhang, Cy Maor, Michael Moshe
arxiv-2512-03270.description: Abstract Thin elastic sheets appear in systems ranging from graphene to biological membranes, where phenomena such as wrinkling, folding, and thermal fluctuations originate from geometric nonlinearities. These effects are treated within weakly nonlinear theories, such as the Föppl–von Kármán equations, which require small slopes and fail when deflections become large even if strains remain small.

arxiv-2606-00446.title: Individually tunable Si/SiGe quantum dot operating voltages via gate-biased illumination
arxiv-2606-00446.creator: Jared Benson, Sanghyeok Park, Owen M. Eskandari, M. A. Wolfe, Brighton X. Coe, J. P. Dodson, S. N. Coppersmith, Mark Friesen, M. A. Eriksson

europmc-pmc3294705.title: Lineage 1 and 2 strains of encephalitic West Nile virus, central Europe.
europmc-pmc3294705.creator: Bakonyi T, Ivanics E, Erdélyi K, Ursu K, Ferenczi E, Weissenböck H, Nowotny N.
europmc-pmc3294705.description: Two different West Nile virus (WNV) strains caused lethal encephalitis in a flock of geese and a goshawk in southeastern Hungary in 2003 and 2004, respectively. During the outbreak in geese, 14 confirmed human cases of WNV encephalitis and meningitis were reported in the same...

europmc-pmc6939418.title: Understanding of ROS-Inducing Strategy in Anticancer Therapy.
europmc-pmc6939418.creator: Kim SJ, Kim HS, Seo YR.
europmc-pmc6939418.description: Redox homeostasis is essential for the maintenance of diverse cellular processes. Cancer cells have higher levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) than normal cells as a result of hypermetabolism, but the redox balance is maintained in cancer cells due to their marked...

pmc-10573843.title: Thyroid Autoimmunity and SARS-CoV-2 Infection
pmc-10573843.creator: Poupak Fallahi, Giusy Elia, Francesca Ragusa, Sabrina Rosaria Paparo, Armando Patrizio, Eugenia Balestri, Valeria Mazzi, Salvatore Benvenga, Gilda Varricchi, Laura Gragnani, Chiara Botrini, Enke Baldini, Marco Centanni, Clodoveo Ferri, Alessandro Antonelli, Silvia Martina Ferrari, François Jamar
pmc-10573843.description: The severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), the etiological culprit of COronaVIrus Disease 19 (COVID-19), can enter the cells via the angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) receptor, which has been found in several tissues including in endocrine organs, such as the ovaries, testes, pancreas, and thyroid.

pmc-10619015.title: First-in-human phase I/Ib study of NIZ985, a recombinant heterodimer of IL-15 and IL-15Rα, as a single agent and in combination with spartalizumab in patients with advanced and metastatic solid tumors
pmc-10619015.creator: Rom Leidner, Kevin Conlon, Douglas G McNeel, Andrea Wang-Gillam, Sumati Gupta, Robert Wesolowski, Monica Chaudhari, Nadia Hassounah, Jong Bong Lee, Lang Ho Lee, Jessica A O’Keeffe, Nancy Lewis, George N Pavlakis, John A Thompson
pmc-10619015.description: BackgroundPreclinically, interleukin-15 (IL-15) monotherapy promotes antitumor immune responses, which are enhanced when IL-15 is used in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). This first-in-human study investigated NIZ985, a recombinant heterodimer comprising physiologically active IL-15 and IL-15 receptor α, as monotherapy and in combination with spartalizumab, an anti-programmed cell death protein-1 (anti-PD-1) monoclonal antibody, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

pmc-11551958.title: Structural Fluctuation in Homodimeric Aminoacyl-tRNA Synthetases Induces Half-of-the-Sites Activity
pmc-11551958.creator: Yoshino Okamoto, Takunori Yasuda, Rikuri Morita, Yasuteru Shigeta, Ryuhei Harada
pmc-11551958.description: Enzymatic activity is regulated by various mechanisms to ensure biologically proper functions. Notable instances of such regulation in homodimeric enzymes include “all-of-the-sites activity” and “half-of-the-sites activity”. The difference in these activities lies in whether one or both of the subunits are simultaneously active. Owing to its uniqueness, the mechanism of half-of-the-sites activity has been widely investigated.

pmc-11638851.title: Novel troponin fragmentation assay to discriminate between Takotsubo syndrome and acute myocardial infarction
pmc-11638851.creator: Juhani K E Airaksinen, Tuulia Tuominen, Tuomas Paana, Tapio Hellman, Tuija Vasankari, Selma Salonen, Helea Junes, Anna Linko-Parvinen, Hanna-Mari Pallari, Marjatta Strandberg, Konsta Teppo, Samuli Jaakkola, Saara Wittfooth
pmc-11638851.description: AimsCardiac troponin levels are elevated in Takotsubo syndrome (TTS) with significant overlap to acute myocardial infarction (MI). Long and intact cardiac troponin T (cTnT) forms are typical for MI. This study sought to assess whether the fragmentation composition of cTnT release in TTS differs from MI.

pmc-11779554.title: Cellular and extracellular white matter alterations after childhood trauma experience in individuals with schizophrenia
pmc-11779554.creator: Maria R. Dauvermann, Laura Costello, Giulia Tronchin, Emma Corley, Laurena Holleran, David Mothersill, Karolina I. Rokita, Ruán Kane, Brian Hallahan, Colm McDonald, Ofer Pasternak, Gary Donohoe, Dara M. Cannon
pmc-11779554.description: BackgroundChildhood trauma (CT) is related to altered fractional anisotropy (FA) in individuals with schizophrenia (SZ). However, it remains unclear whether CT may influence specific cellular or extracellular compartments of FA in SZ with CT experience. We extended our previous study on FA in SZ (Costello et al.

pmc-12429089.title: Biotic and Abiotic Factors Influencing Maize Plant Height
pmc-12429089.creator: Zixu Ma, Chunxia Liang, Haoyue Wang, Jieshan Liu, Xiangyan Zhou, Wenqi Zhou, De-Guo Han, Hongbin Zhang
pmc-12429089.description: This paper examines various aspects of maize plant height. Firstly, it emphasizes that maize is a significant food and forage crop with considerable research significance, and that its plant height is influenced by multiple factors, including biotic elements such as genes and plant hormones, as well as abiotic factors such as soil, water, and climate.

pmc-12747329.title: Assessment of the midgut microbiota in foragers of the stingless bee Melipona scutellaris following short-term sublethal exposure to imidacloprid
pmc-12747329.creator: Patricia Azevedo, Lucas Miotelo, Manuela Oliveira Ramalho, Tatiane Caroline Grella, Osmar Malaspina, Matthew Hudson, Roberta Cornélio Ferreira Nocelli, Maria Imaculada Zucchi
pmc-12747329.description: The insecticide imidacloprid, widely used in Brazil, is known to have adverse effects on bee populations at both lethal and sublethal doses and concentrations. While previous studies have reported disruption of bee gut microbial communities following pesticide exposure, the effects of short-term sublethal exposure in stingless bees remain unclear.

pmc-13234448.title: Disparities in digital information exchange and interoperability among family medicine physicians in the United States
pmc-13234448.creator: Kate E Trout, Jeongyoung Park
pmc-13234448.description: ObjectiveThis study examines disparities in the use of interoperability features within the EHR among family medicine physicians in the United States, particularly in areas with higher social deprivation index and rural settings.Materials and MethodsUsing data from the 2022 American Board of Family Medicine Continuous Certification Questionnaire, we assessed the association between self-reported interoperability and social deprivation.

pmc-13248421.title: Reconstructing a typology of approaches to navigating diversity: a comparative qualitative study of German nursing teams
pmc-13248421.creator: Lisa Peppler, Martin Feißt, Maja Apelt, Liane Schenk
pmc-13248421.description: BackgroundGermany faces a severe nursing shortage, increasingly addressed by international recruitment. This shift results in growing socio-cultural and educational diversity within nursing teams. While the experiences of migrant nurses are well-documented, how receiving teams manage this diversity in daily practice remains under-researched. This study investigates team-level patterns of navigating diversity and identifies factors influencing successful integration.

pmc-13256776.title: Evolving Approaches to Bacterial Identification: A Review of Classical and Modern Techniques
pmc-13256776.creator: Ina Gajic, Milos Jovicevic, Dusan Kekic, Jovana Kabic, Ivan Vicic, Bojana Lukovic, Ana Tomic, Olja Sovljanski, Mila Skoric, Iva Sikanic, Marko Jankovic, Aleksandra Smitran, Ljiljana Bozic, Bojan Golic, Jasmina Basic, Nedjeljko Karabasil, Natasa Opavski
pmc-13256776.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Infectious diseases remain a major global health concern, with a growing burden of antimicrobial resistance and consequent higher mortality in the human population. Accurate bacterial identification is fundamental across clinical, veterinary, agricultural, and research settings, supporting effective diagnosis, antimicrobial stewardship, infection control, food safety, and environmental monitoring; however, conventional approaches are limited by time constraints, reduced sensitivity, and challenges in detecting fastidious or uncultivable organisms.

pmc-13414066.title: Atomic-Scale Investigation of Deformation Behavior and Dislocation Evolution During Metal Spinning Based on Molecular Dynamics Simulations
pmc-13414066.creator: Piyao Liu, Linsen Song, Ziwei Jiang, Zhenhui Li, Wei Liang, Xuanda He
pmc-13414066.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Localized stress concentration and defect accumulation are prone to occurring during metal spinning because of the coupled effects of complex loading and interfacial friction. In this study, a molecular dynamics model of metal spinning was established to investigate the effects of process parameters and temperature on the mechanical response, material flow, contact loading, and dislocation evolution behavior within the contact zone.

pmc-13570236.title: Multicentre outbreak of Candida viswanathii bloodstream infections linked to contaminated milrinone, Italy, April to October 2025
pmc-13570236.creator: Alessio Mesini, Giuseppe Spiga, Marta Ciofi Degli Atti, Debora Contu, Carmen D’Amore, Elisabetta Ugolotti, Gianluca Vrenna, Marco Castignone, Venere Cortazzo, Marco Merli, Lara Ricotta, Elisa Matarazzo, Elena De Carolis, Elisa De Pasqual, Maurizio Sanguinetti, Chiara Vismara, Paola Bernaschi, Anna M
pmc-13570236.description: In 2025, a multicentre outbreak of bloodstream infections caused by Candida viswanathii, a rare non-albicans Candida species, was identified in Italy. The source was recognised after four C. viswanathii bloodstream infections were identified within a short period at a single centre. Initial local investigations did not identify environmental or patient-to-patient transmission. Given the strong geographical association of C.

pmc-13649260.title: Effectiveness of organizational interventions vs usual care for reducing incidence and mitigating impact of workplace violence on registered nurses: a systematic review protocol
pmc-13649260.creator: Domenico Cannizzaro, Ilaria Saguatti, Dalia Caleffi, Sergio Rovesti, Paola Ferri
pmc-13649260.description: Objective:The objective of this review will be to evaluate the effectiveness of multilevel interventions, including communication strategies and other organizational measures targeting structures, processes, policies, and culture, compared to usual care or no intervention, in reducing the incidence and severity of verbal and physical workplace violence against registered nurses.

uslaw-usc-t15-s6553.title: 15 U.S.C. § 6553 — Annual reports
uslaw-usc-t15-s6553.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s6553.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 91A (Promoting A Safe Internet For Children). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Commission shall submit a report to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation of the Senate and the Committee on Energy and Commerce of the House of Representatives not later than March 31 of each year that describes the activities.
